title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
abstract: arXiv:2608.26623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, evaluated with five generators (3B-70B open-weight models and GPT-5.4) and six judges (20B to frontier scale) under paired with- and without-ground-truth conditions. translated_title: AgentJudgeBench：一个用于评估LLM裁判在智能体工具调用上的多难度基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26623v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM裁判被广泛用于评估智能体工具调用系统，但它们在结构化、依赖驱动的工作流上的可靠性在很大程度上仍未得到检验。我们提出了AgentJudgeBench，这是第一个系统研究LLM作为裁判在基于工作流DAG的智能体工具调用上可靠性的基准，不同于更广泛的LLM作为裁判在开放式文本或偏好评估任务上的应用。该基准包含3,808个实例，涵盖六种DAG拓扑和三个难度层级，使用五个生成器（3B-70B开放权重模型和GPT-5.4）和六个裁判（从20B到前沿规模）在有无真实标签的配对条件下进行评估。裁判与真实标签的一致性随任务难度单调下降，在无真实标签时下降速度快1.5倍，且在无真实标签的困难查询上，所有六个裁判无论规模大小都收敛到77-82%的狭窄区间，揭示了一个主要由任务难度驱动的结构性上限，尽管其高度受限于此。
tldr: 该论文提出了AgentJudgeBench基准，发现LLM裁判在智能体工具调用任务上的可靠性随难度单调下降，且在无真实标签的困难任务中所有裁判均达到相似的结构性性能上限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentJudgeBench and finds that LLM judges' reliability on agentic tool-calling degrades monotonically with task difficulty, converging to a structural ceiling in hard no-ground-truth scenarios regardless of judge scale.
